trail.name: Hidden Falls via Round-trip Shuttle
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS West Shore Boat Dock marker. Area forecast reference for the walking start after the crossing; not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: NPS publishes this as the shorter shuttle-boat hike. Allow extra time for boat travel, queues and parking-to-dock access.

accessRoute.label: Round-trip shuttle + hike
accessRoute.start: East Shore Boat Dock for the crossing; hike from West Shore Boat Dock
accessRoute.returnPlan: Hike back to the west dock, then take the return boat to the east dock.
accessRoute.distanceScope: West-dock hiking out and back. Boat crossings and parking-to-dock access are not included.

comparison.summary: Comparable public west-dock route to Hidden Falls. NPS remains authoritative for distance, gain and difficulty when public metrics differ.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration for the Hidden Falls shuttle-boat itinerary.

comparison.note: Connected NPS-origin USGS trail segments from the west-dock corridor to Hidden Falls and back total 1.119 mi versus NPS 1.0 mi. Boat travel and dock connectors are excluded. This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.

photo.alt: Water cascades down a 100 ft waterfall tucked into a forest of conifer trees.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied.
